about: Test vectors a browser checks with WebCrypto. See docs/ponds.md, Web guests. All binary values are base64 (padded), except ids and secrets, base64url.

signing.note: ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of `${path}\n${box}`; the signature is r||s, 64 bytes (WebCrypto's native output). The public key is the raw uncompressed point (importKey 'raw'); the private key is PKCS#8 (importKey 'pkcs8').

seal.note: box = '<keyVersion>.' + base64(nonce12 || ciphertext || tag16). AES-256-GCM, key = base64 32 bytes, additionalData = UTF-8 of the document path. WebCrypto's encrypt returns ciphertext||tag, so append that to the nonce.

ecies.note: box = base64(ephemeralPublic65 || nonce12 || ciphertext || tag16). ECDH P-256 with the ephemeral key, HKDF-SHA256 (salt = the 65 ephemeral public bytes, info = UTF-8 'squeak-pond-key-v1', 32 bytes) gives the AES-256-GCM key; no additional data.

joinProof.note: hex HMAC-SHA256 keyed by base64url-decoded secret over `${requestId}\n${publicKey}` (publicKey as base64 text).
